title: Jimmy Savile at Chequers and the hospital key

tellings.quote:
Jimmy Savile was so influential in the
UK that he was spending his Christmases
at checkers where the prime minister
would spend it

plain: Jimmy Savile, a famous British entertainer, was so powerful in the United Kingdom that he spent his Christmases at Chequers, the country house where the British prime minister spends the holiday. Jay Anderson, a guest on the show, tells Michels this as part of a story about Savile's reach between 1960 and 2011, offering it as a sign of how close Savile stood to the top of British power.
